title: agentkeel
description: Security (SPEC/06 section 6, R1). Panel 1 is the registry: one row per agent, read through Athena's DynamoDB connector from the table agentkeel-registry and nothing else. validate refuses a panel 1 target on any other data source or table (src/validate/panel.py). Imported into the workspace by hand; the data source uid 'registry' is the Athena data source the workspace's README names.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT name, repository, commit_sha, deployed_at FROM "agentkeel_registry"."default"."agentkeel-registry" ORDER BY name
